papers.title: Role of circulating tumour DNA in predicting complete clinical response and local regrowth after total neoadjuvant therapy for rectal cancer: meta-analysis
papers.authors: Lal N, Shukla S, Hodges N, Brown G, Jenkins J
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Non-operative management after total neoadjuvant therapy (TNT) has emerged as a potential strategy for patients with locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC) achieving clinical complete response (cCR). Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) has been proposed as a systemic biomarker to augment response assessment, but its role in predicting cCR and local regrowth remains uncertain.
METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis were performed of studies evaluating ctDNA dynamics in patients with LARC undergoing TNT. PubMed, EMBASE, and Web of Science databases were searched from database inception to 31 March 2026. Primary outcomes were the association between post-TNT ctDNA status and cCR and sustained cCR. Pooled odds ratios (ORs) were calculated using a random-effects model.
RESULTS: Six studies comprising 597 patients were included. ctDNA negativity following TNT was associated with higher likelihood of cCR (OR 8.01; 95% confidence interval (c.i.) 1.43 to 44.90; I2 = 27.0%). The association with sustained cCR was not statistically significant (OR 3.46; 95% c.i. 0.03 to 394.64; I2 = 59.9%). Across studies, post-TNT ctDNA positivity was associated with inferior disease-free, distant recurrence-free, and progression-free survival. ctDNA demonstrated high specificity and positive predictive value for residual disease, but low sensitivity for the detection of residual local disease and local regrowth, with a substantial proportion of patients with residual tumour remaining ctDNA negative at restaging.
CONCLUSION: Post-TNT ctDNA positivity may identify patients at increased risk of adverse oncological outcomes. However, ctDNA negativity was not consistently associated with the absence of residual local disease, limiting its utility as an independent determinant of organ preservation eligibility. ctDNA should be interpreted as a complementary tool for systemic risk stratification alongside established anatomical assessment.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：全直腸新輔助治療（TNT）後之非手術治療已成為局部進行性直腸癌（LARC）達到臨床完全緩解（cCR）病人的潛在治療策略。循環腫瘤DNA（ctDNA）被提議作為系統性生物標記以輔助反應評估，但其在預測cCR與局部再生長中的角色仍不確定。

方法：針對評估LARC病人接受TNT後ctDNA動態變化之研究進行系統性回顧與統合分析。搜尋PubMed、EMBASE與Web of Science資料庫，自建庫起至2026年3月31日。主要結果為TNT後ctDNA狀態與cCR及持續性cCR之關聯性。採用隨機效應模型計算合併勝算比（OR）。

結果：共納入6項研究、597名病人。TNT後ctDNA陰性與較高的cCR可能性相關（OR 8.01；95%信賴區間1.43至44.90；I2=27.0%）。與持續性cCR之關聯未達統計顯著（OR 3.46；95%信賴區間0.03至394.64；I2=59.9%）。各研究中，TNT後ctDNA陽性與較差的無病存活、無遠端復發存活及無疾病進展存活相關。ctDNA對殘餘疾病之偵測顯示高特異性與高陽性預測值，但對殘餘局部疾病與局部再生長之偵測敏感性低，相當比例有殘餘腫瘤之病人在重新分期時仍呈ctDNA陰性。

結論：TNT後ctDNA陽性可能可辨識出腫瘤學預後較差風險較高之病人。然而，ctDNA陰性並不一致地與無殘餘局部疾病相關，限制其作為器官保留適用性之獨立判定工具的實用性。ctDNA應被視為與既有解剖學評估並用之系統性風險分層輔助工具。

papers.title: Learning curves in robotic and laparoscopic colorectal surgery: a systematic review
papers.authors: Nocera F, Wiedemann F, Müller P, Billeter A, Angehrn F, Müller B
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate and compare learning-curve assessment in laparoscopic and robotic colorectal surgery and to develop a standardized framework for future learning-curve reporting.
BACKGROUND: Learning curves in minimally invasive colorectal surgery are widely reported, but inconsistent definitions limit interpretability and comparability. This systematic review analyzed learning-curve assessment in laparoscopic and robotic colorectal surgery and proposes a standardized framework.
METHODS: MEDLINE, Web of Science, and CENTRAL were systematically searched according to PRISMA guidelines (registered in PROSPERO, CRD42026128860). Included were randomized, prospective, and retrospective studies on learning curves in colorectal surgery. Primary outcome was the number of procedures required to reach the initial learning phase. Secondary outcomes included definitions of learning curves, analytical methods, and classification of learning phases. Analyses were stratified by procedure type (colon vs. rectal resections), and pooled breakpoint regression was used to identify learning phases.
RESULTS: A total of 114 studies comprising 167 learning-curve analyses were included. CUSUM or risk-adjusted CUSUM was used in 66.4% of analyses, whereas 33.3% applied arbitrary definitions; operative time was the most frequently used endpoint (79.6%). Operative-time plateaus were identified after 38 colonic and 56 rectal procedures. Reported median competency thresholds were numerically lower for robotic than laparoscopic surgery in colonic resections (24 vs. 30 cases; p = 0.659) and rectal resections (28 vs. 38 cases; p = 0.140), but these differences were not statistically significant.
CONCLUSIONS: Learning-curve assessment in minimally invasive colorectal surgery remains heterogeneous. Robotic series report numerically lower competency thresholds than laparoscopic series; however, this likely reflects skill transfer from prior laparoscopic experience and modern training pathways rather than an intrinsically shorter learning curve of the robotic platform. Differences in prior surgeon experience, training, and study era limit direct comparison. Standardized assessment and prospective studies with comparable baseline exposure are needed.

papers.title_zh: 機器手臂與腹腔鏡大腸直腸手術學習曲線之系統性回顧
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：評估並比較腹腔鏡與機器手臂大腸直腸手術之學習曲線評估方式，並建立未來學習曲線報告之標準化框架。背景：微創大腸直腸手術之學習曲線被廣泛報導，但定義不一致限制了其可解釋性與可比較性。本系統性回顧分析腹腔鏡與機器手臂大腸直腸手術的學習曲線評估，並提出標準化框架。方法：依PRISMA準則系統性搜尋MEDLINE、Web of Science及CENTRAL（已於PROSPERO登錄，CRD42026128860）。納入隨機、前瞻性與回溯性之大腸直腸手術學習曲線研究。主要outcome為達到初始學習階段所需之手術例數。次要outcome包括學習曲線之定義、分析方法及學習階段之分類。分析依手術類型（結腸 vs 直腸切除）分層，並以彙總斷點迴歸（pooled breakpoint regression）識別學習階段。結果：共納入114篇研究，包含167個學習曲線分析。66.4%之分析使用CUSUM或風險校正CUSUM，33.3%採用任意性定義；手術時間是最常用之終點指標（79.6%）。手術時間平穩期（plateau）於結腸手術38例、直腸手術56例後出現。報告之中位能力門檻數值上機器手臂低於腹腔鏡：結腸切除（24例 vs 30例；p=0.659），直腸切除（28例 vs 38例；p=0.140），但此差異未達統計顯著。結論：微創大腸直腸手術之學習曲線評估仍具高度異質性。機器手臂系列報告之能力門檻數值上低於腹腔鏡系列；然而這較可能反映先前腹腔鏡經驗之技能轉移及現代訓練途徑，而非機器手臂平台本身具有較短之學習曲線。術者先前經驗、訓練方式及研究年代之差異限制了直接比較。需要標準化評估方式及基線暴露可比較之前瞻性研究。

papers.title: Epidemiology of inflammatory bowel disease in the Middle East and North Africa: a multinational, tertiary care registry (MIRAGE) study
papers.authors: Shehab M, Azzam N, Al-Hindawi A, Alrashed F, Al-Bawardy B, Abid S
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is increasing in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), yet region-specific evidence on phenotype and treatment patterns remains limited. We aimed to characterize IBD epidemiology, clinical phenotypes, and therapy use across MENA centers.
METHODS: This was a multicenter cross-sectional study across 13 centers in seven MENA countries. Adults with ulcerative colitis (UC), Crohn's disease (CD), or IBD-unclassified (IBD-U) were included. Demographics, Montreal phenotype/behavior, smoking status, disease duration, perianal disease, and therapies were collected. Descriptive statistics and between-group comparisons were performed.
RESULTS: We analyzed 10 340 patients (52% UC, 45% CD, 3% IBD-U). Mean age was 39.79 ± 14.4 years in UC and 34.57 ± 12.9 years in CD (P < .0001). UC patients were slightly more often female (51.6%), while CD patients were male-predominant (59.0%). Current smoking was more common in CD than in UC (12.0% vs 5.6%). Mean disease duration was 9.73 ± 7.5 years, longest in Jordan (14.1 years) and shortest in Qatar (2.45 years; P < .001). Biologic exposure differed by subtype (P < .001), with the highest rate in CD (57.9%). In UC, extensive colitis (E3) was the most common phenotype. In CD, ileocolonic involvement (L3) predominated with mainly non-stricturing, non-penetrating behavior (B1). Perianal disease affected approximately 13% overall, with rates varying by country, highest in UAE and lowest in Egypt and Qatar.
CONCLUSION: This multi-country hospital-based registry study helps define contemporary IBD patterns in MENA: slight UC predominance, high rates of extensive UC and ileocolonic B1 CD, and heterogeneous biologic use. Our data provide insights into regional IBD epidemiological trends and treatment adoption.
papers.title_zh: 中東及北非地區發炎性腸道疾病之流行病學：多國第三級照護登記研究（MIRAGE研究）
papers.abstract_zh: 背景與目的：發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）在中東及北非（MENA）地區的發生率正在上升，但該區域針對疾病表現型與治療模式的證據仍有限。本研究旨在描述MENA各中心IBD的流行病學、臨床表現型與治療使用情況。方法：這是一項橫跨7個MENA國家、13個中心的多中心橫斷面研究。納入患有潰瘍性結腸炎（UC）、克隆氏症（CD）或未分類IBD（IBD-U）的成年患者。收集人口統計學、Montreal表現型/行為分類、吸菸狀態、病程、肛周疾病及治療方式。進行描述性統計與組間比較。結果：共分析10,340名患者（52% UC，45% CD，3% IBD-U）。UC患者平均年齡為39.79 ± 14.4歲，CD患者為34.57 ± 12.9歲（P < .0001）。UC患者女性稍多（51.6%），而CD患者則以男性為主（59.0%）。目前吸菸比例在CD患者中較UC患者更高（12.0% vs 5.6%）。平均病程為9.73 ± 7.5年，約旦最長（14.1年），卡達最短（2.45年；P < .001）。生物製劑使用率依亞型不同而有差異（P < .001），CD患者使用率最高（57.9%）。在UC患者中，廣泛性結腸炎（E3）是最常見的表現型。在CD患者中，以迴結腸型（L3）為主，且主要為非狹窄非穿透型（B1）。肛周疾病整體影響約13%患者，各國比例不同，阿拉伯聯合大公國最高，埃及與卡達最低。結論：此多國醫院基礎登記研究有助於定義MENA地區當代IBD的模式：UC略占優勢、UC廣泛型比例高、CD以迴結腸型B1為主，以及生物製劑使用的異質性。本研究數據提供了區域IBD流行病學趨勢與治療採用情況的洞見。

papers.title: Cancer statistics for Hispanic/Latino people, 2026
papers.journal_full: CA: a cancer journal for clinicians
papers.authors: Saka A, Kratzer T, Giaquinto A, Mazzitelli N, Pinheiro P, Ortiz A
papers.abstract: The Hispanic/Latino population is the second largest racial and ethnic group in the United States, accounting for 20% of the total population (68 million), plus approximately 3 million Hispanic Americans residing in Puerto Rico. Herein, the American Cancer Society reports cancer occurrence, risk factors, and screening for US Hispanic people using federally funded, high-quality, population-based cancer registry data and national vital statistics and survey data. In 2026, an estimated 229,900 Hispanic people will be diagnosed with cancer, and 54,200 will die from the disease in the continental United States and Hawaii. Cancer incidence during 1998-2022 rose in Hispanic women (from 345 to 385 per 100,000) and fell in Hispanic men (from 471 to 389 per 100,000), narrowing the male-to-female incidence rate ratio from a peak of 1.40 (95% CI, 1.38-1.42) in 2002 to 1.01 (95% CI, 1.00-1.02; p = .02) in 2022. This pattern is partly driven by declining incidence of lung and prostate cancers among men and increasing incidence of breast and uterine corpus cancers among women. Although temporal trends mirror the general population, the Hispanic cancer distribution is distinct, consistent with relatively lower prevalence of smoking, alcohol drinking, and screening and higher prevalence of obesity and cancer-causing infections. Compared with White people, Hispanic people have one half the incidence of lung and urinary bladder cancers and 24% lower breast cancer but double the rate of liver, stomach, and gallbladder cancers, 61%-65% higher acute lymphocytic leukemia, and 36% higher cervical cancer. The cancer burden in Puerto Rico is distinct, with lower rates of lung cancer but higher rates of cervical, prostate, and colorectal cancers compared with other US Hispanic populations. Residents in Puerto Rico also experience lasting health care system challenges from extreme weather events. Thus, prevention efforts should target the unique cancer profile of the Hispanic population, including infection prevention and control, healthy eating, physical activity, and routine screening, especially for cervical and colorectal cancer that are 11 percentage points lower than White people.

papers.title_zh: 2026年西裔/拉丁裔人群癌症統計
papers.abstract_zh: 西裔/拉丁裔人群是美國第二大種族與族群，佔總人口20%（6800萬人），另有約300萬西裔美國人居住於波多黎各。本文中，美國癌症協會運用聯邦資助、高品質、以人群為基礎的癌症登記資料，以及全國生命統計與調查資料，報告美國西裔人口的癌症發生率、風險因子與篩檢狀況。2026年，預估美國本土及夏威夷將有229,900名西裔人口被診斷為癌症，54,200人將因此死亡。1998-2022年間，西裔女性癌症發生率上升（每10萬人345例升至385例），西裔男性則下降（每10萬人471例降至389例），使男女發生率比從2002年峰值1.40（95% CI, 1.38-1.42）縮小至2022年的1.01（95% CI, 1.00-1.02; p = .02）。此趨勢部分源自男性肺癌與前列腺癌發生率下降，以及女性乳癌與子宮體癌發生率上升。雖然時間趨勢與一般人群相似，但西裔癌症分布具有獨特性，與其抽菸、飲酒及篩檢率相對較低，而肥胖與致癌感染相對較高一致。與白人相比，西裔人口肺癌與膀胱癌發生率為一半，乳癌低24%，但肝癌、胃癌與膽囊癌發生率為兩倍，急性淋巴性白血病高61%-65%，子宮頸癌高36%。波多黎各的癌症負擔具有獨特性，肺癌率較低，但子宮頸癌、前列腺癌與大腸直腸癌率較其他美國西裔人口更高。波多黎各居民也因極端天氣事件而持續面臨醫療體系挑戰。因此，預防措施應針對西裔人群獨特的癌症概況，包括感染防治、健康飲食、身體活動及常規篩檢，尤其是子宮頸癌與大腸直腸癌篩檢率比白人低11個百分點之處。

papers.title: Malignancy in patients with acromegaly: a multicenter study across the Gulf region
papers.authors: AlDahmani K, Mahzari M, Elhadd T, Aziz F, Ekhzaimy A, Jaber T
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Chronic growth hormone and insulin-like growth factor 1 excess may promote tumorigenesis, but the magnitude of malignancy risk in acromegaly remains uncertain and regional data from the Gulf are limited.
OBJECTIVE: To describe the frequency, spectrum, detection, outcomes, and clinical correlates of malignancy among patients with acromegaly treated across Gulf tertiary centers.
DESIGN: Multicenter retrospective observational study.
SETTING: Five tertiary centers across Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and the United Arab Emirates.
PATIENTS AND METHODS: Medical records of patients aged >16 years with acromegaly who were evaluated from 2010 through 2024 were reviewed. Demographic, disease, treatment, cancer-testing, and malignancy data were collected. Group comparisons were descriptive and exploratory because only 10 malignancies occurred.
MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: Documented malignancy frequency, cancer type, method of detection, stage, treatment, outcome, and clinical correlates.
SAMPLE SIZE: 157 patients.
RESULTS: The mean age was 47.1 years, 101 patients (64.3%) were male, and the mean disease duration was 9.4 years. Malignancy was documented in 10 patients (6.4%), most commonly papillary thyroid carcinoma (8/10). Two of the eight papillary thyroid carcinomas were classified as T1a (≤10 mm); exact pathology measurements were not consistently available. One patient had colorectal cancer, and one had prostate cancer. Exploratory comparisons showed that patients with malignancy were older than those without malignancy (mean age, 56.6 vs 46.5 years; P=.039). The remaining comparisons were inconclusive. All patients with malignancy were in remission or had an excellent response at the last documented follow-up.
CONCLUSION: Malignancy was documented in 6.4% (10 out of 157) in this multi-center Gulf acromegaly cohort, predominantly papillary thyroid carcinoma. The findings support individualized surveillance based on population guidance, symptoms, family history, and clinical findings rather than an acromegaly-specific screening program.
LIMITATIONS: Retrospective design, small number of malignancy events, missing data, lack of a population comparator, and nonstandardized cancer testing may introduce selection and detection biases.
papers.title_zh: 肢端肥大症患者之惡性腫瘤：波斯灣地區多中心研究
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：慢性生長激素與類胰島素生長因子1過高可能促進腫瘤生成，但肢端肥大症患者的惡性腫瘤風險程度仍不明確，且波斯灣地區的區域性資料有限。目的：描述波斯灣三級醫療中心肢端肥大症患者中惡性腫瘤的發生頻率、種類、偵測方式、預後及臨床相關因素。設計：多中心回溯性觀察研究。場域：沙烏地阿拉伯、卡達、阿拉伯聯合大公國共五家三級醫療中心。病人與方法：回顧2010年至2024年間就診、年齡大於16歲之肢端肥大症病人病歷，收集人口學、疾病、治療、癌症篩檢及惡性腫瘤相關資料。因僅發生10例惡性腫瘤，組間比較僅為描述性及探索性。主要結果測量：記載之惡性腫瘤發生頻率、癌症類型、偵測方法、分期、治療及預後、臨床相關因素。樣本數：157位病人。結果：平均年齡47.1歲，101位（64.3%）為男性，平均病程9.4年。10位病人（6.4%）記錄有惡性腫瘤，最常見為乳突狀甲狀腺癌（8/10）。八例乳突狀甲狀腺癌中有兩例分類為T1a（≤10mm）；確切病理測量值並非都能取得。一位病人罹患大腸直腸癌，一位罹患攝護腺癌。探索性比較顯示有惡性腫瘤之病人較無惡性腫瘤者年長（平均年齡56.6歲 vs 46.5歲，P=.039）。其餘比較結果不確定。所有惡性腫瘤病人於最後一次追蹤記錄時皆已緩解或反應極佳。結論：此波斯灣多中心肢端肥大症世代中，6.4%（157例中10例）記錄有惡性腫瘤，以乳突狀甲狀腺癌為主。研究結果支持依據族群指引、症狀、家族史及臨床發現進行個別化監測，而非採行肢端肥大症特異性篩檢計畫。限制：回溯性設計、惡性腫瘤事件數少、資料缺漏、缺乏族群對照組、癌症篩檢方式未標準化，可能造成選擇性偏誤與偵測偏誤。

papers.title: Opportunistic Gastric Cancer Endoscopic Screening Integrated Into Population-Based Colorectal Cancer Screening: A Retrospective Economic Cost-Comparison Study
papers.authors: Mourato B, Pinto P, Vieira J, Vidinha M, Carvalho V, Pratas N
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Gastric cancer (GC) remains a major cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with prognosis and treatment costs strongly influenced by disease stage at diagnosis. Endoscopic GC screening has been proposed for intermediate-to-high-risk countries, although its economic feasibility remains uncertain. This study evaluated the costs associated with opportunistic GC screening integrated into a colorectal cancer screening programme and compared modeled early-stage management scenarios with the real-world costs of managing Stages II-IV disease.
METHODS: A retrospective cost-comparison study was conducted from the perspective of the Portuguese National Health Service. Screening costs were derived from 377 fecal immunochemical testing-positive individuals undergoing one-time opportunistic esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD) during colonoscopy within the organized colorectal cancer screening programme, and treatment costs from a retrospective cohort of 222 patients with gastric adenocarcinoma. Direct medical costs were analyzed according to disease stage and compared with two modeled early-stage management scenarios.
RESULTS: Gastric precancerous conditions were identified in 46.9% of screened individuals, and gastric adenocarcinoma was detected in 0.8% (3/377). The estimated screening cost was €17,249 per cancer detected. Mean treatment and follow-up costs per patient were €32,140 for Stage II disease, €33,073 for Stage III disease, and €19,287 for Stage IV disease. The estimated cumulative cost of screening followed by ESD was €27,624, whereas screening followed by surgical treatment of Stage I disease was estimated at €44,493.
CONCLUSIONS: GC management is associated with substantial healthcare expenditure. The potential economic value of opportunistic GC screening is likely to depend on the detection of lesions amenable to endoscopic treatment.
TRAIL REGISTRATION: NCT07522320.

papers.title_zh: 將胃癌內視鏡篩檢整合至人群大腸直腸癌篩檢計畫：一項回溯性經濟成本比較研究
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：胃癌（GC）仍是全球癌症相關死亡的主要原因，其預後與治療成本深受診斷時期影響。已有人提議在中高風險國家進行內視鏡胃癌篩檢，但其經濟可行性仍不確定。本研究評估將機會性胃癌篩檢整合至大腸直腸癌篩檢計畫的成本，並比較模擬的早期管理情境與第II-IV期疾病的真實世界管理成本。方法：本回溯性成本比較研究以葡萄牙國家健康服務體系的角度進行。篩檢成本來自377名糞便免疫化學檢測陽性者，於組織化大腸直腸癌篩檢計畫中接受大腸鏡檢查時，同時進行單次機會性上消化道內視鏡檢查（EGD）；治療成本則來自222名胃腺癌病人的回溯性世代。依疾病期別分析直接醫療成本，並與兩種模擬早期管理情境比較。結果：46.9%的受篩檢者發現胃癌前病變，0.8%（3/377）偵測到胃腺癌。每偵測一例癌症的估計篩檢成本為17,249歐元。每位病人之平均治療與追蹤成本：第II期為32,140歐元，第III期為33,073歐元，第IV期為19,287歐元。篩檢後接受內視鏡黏膜下剝離術（ESD）的估計累積成本為27,624歐元，而篩檢後對第I期疾病進行手術治療的估計成本為44,493歐元。結論：胃癌管理伴隨龐大醫療支出。機會性胃癌篩檢的潛在經濟價值可能取決於能否偵測到適合內視鏡治療的病灶。試驗註冊：NCT07522320。

papers.title: Primary K-pouch creation versus J-to-K pouch conversion: An IDEAL stage 3 report
papers.journal_full: Colorectal disease : the official journal of the Association of Coloproctology of Great Britain and Ireland
papers.authors: Abbasi A, Ge Y, Jia M, Testerman E, Marra V, Autencio K
papers.abstract:
AIM: Conversion of a failed ileoanal J-pouch to a continent ileostomy (K-pouch) is an uncommon salvage option that may preserve continence and small-bowel length. Outcomes after J-to-K pouch conversion compared with primary K-pouch creation remain poorly defined. This IDEAL stage 3 study compared short- and long-term outcomes between these two approaches.
METHOD: We performed a retrospective review of patients undergoing primary K-pouch creation or J-to-K pouch conversion at a tertiary referral centre between 2013 and 2025. Demographic, clinical and operative characteristics, 30-day postoperative outcomes and long-term pouch-related outcomes were evaluated. Primary outcomes were pouch revision and pouch excision. Secondary outcomes included 30-day morbidity and other long-term complications.
RESULTS: Forty-four patients were included, of whom 28 underwent primary K-pouch creation and 16 underwent J-to-K pouch conversion. Median age, body mass index, operation duration and blood loss were comparable between groups. Thirty-day outcomes, including readmission, reoperation, ileus, abscess and transfusion, did not differ significantly. After a median follow-up of 43 vs. 42 months, pouch survival remained high in both groups (82.1% vs. 93.8%, p = 0.39). Kaplan-Meier analysis demonstrated similar revision-free (p = 0.39) and excision-free (p = 0.36) survival. On multivariable analysis, 30-day transfusion was the only independent predictor of pouch failure (odds ratio [OR] 7.56, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.02-56.25; p = 0.048).
CONCLUSION: J-to-K pouch conversion achieved high pouch survival and 30-day morbidity comparable to primary K-pouch creation, supporting its role as an effective salvage option in selected patients with J-pouch failure.
papers.title_zh: 原位K-pouch製作與J轉K-pouch轉換：一項IDEAL第三階段報告
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：將失敗的迴腸肛門J型儲袋轉換為可控性迴腸造口（K-pouch）是一種少見的補救選項，可能保留肛門自制功能與小腸長度。J轉K-pouch轉換與原位K-pouch製作兩者的預後比較至今仍不明確。本IDEAL第三階段研究比較了這兩種方式的短期與長期預後。方法：我們回溯性回顧2013年至2025年間於一所三級轉診中心接受原位K-pouch製作或J轉K-pouch轉換的病人。評估人口學、臨床與手術特徵、術後30天結果及長期儲袋相關預後。主要結果為儲袋翻修與儲袋切除。次要結果包括30天併發症發生率及其他長期併發症。結果：共納入44位病人，其中28位接受原位K-pouch製作，16位接受J轉K-pouch轉換。兩組間的中位年齡、身體質量指數、手術時間及出血量相當。30天結果，包括再入院、再手術、腸阻塞、膿瘍及輸血，組間無顯著差異。中位追蹤43個月 vs 42個月後，兩組儲袋存活率皆高（82.1% vs 93.8%，p = 0.39）。Kaplan-Meier分析顯示兩組的無翻修存活率（p = 0.39）與無切除存活率（p = 0.36）相似。多變量分析顯示，30天內輸血是儲袋失敗的唯一獨立預測因子（勝算比[OR] 7.56，95%信賴區間 1.02–56.25；p = 0.048）。結論：J轉K-pouch轉換達到與原位K-pouch製作相當的高儲袋存活率及30天併發症發生率，支持其作為J型儲袋失敗病人中經篩選後的有效補救選項。

papers.title: Characterization of SPP1 + macrophages and their correlation with resistance to neoadjuvant chemotherapy in colorectal cancer liver metastasis
papers.authors: Tang J, Hao W, He X, Qian X, Ruan L, Quan M
papers.abstract: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) for colorectal cancer liver metastasis (CRLM) remains a major clinical challenge, with outcomes varying widely among patients, yet the mechanisms that drive therapeutic resistance remain incompletely understood. In this study, we integrated single‑cell RNA‑sequencing and spatial transcriptomics of patient tumor specimens to dissect the interplay between the hepatic tumor microenvironment and chemotherapy resistance. We identified a specific macrophage subpopulation marked by elevated expression of Secreted Phosphoprotein 1 (SPP1) that is significantly enriched in insufficient responders to NAC. Mechanistically, these SPP1 + macrophages exhibit a pro‑tumoral transcriptomic profile and directly suppress CD8 + T cell cytotoxic function through the SPP1‑CD44 signaling axis, as demonstrated by in vitro co‑culture assays, a large‑scale tissue microarray, and multiple syngeneic mouse models. Spatially, they are scattered throughout the tumour and form dense barriers that sequester CD8 + T cells and drive their exhaustion. Strikingly, this spatial configuration inversely correlates with cytotoxic activity and adaptive immune signatures and thereby reinforces a local immunosuppressive niche that sustains chemoresistance. These data provide the missing link: effective chemotherapy requires an immune‑active hepatic microenvironment, and SPP1 + macrophage infiltration actively disrupts this state, which in turn promotes clinical resistance. In a preclinical CRLM model, SPP1 blockade synergised with anti‑PD‑1, inducing significant tumour regression and restoring T‑cell function. Collectively, our findings position SPP1 + macrophages as central drivers of NAC resistance in CRLM and highlight the spatial immune barrier they create as a promising therapeutic target for overcoming chemoresistance and improving immunotherapy responses.

papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌肝轉移（CRLM）的新輔助化療（NAC）仍是重大臨床挑戰，病人反應差異甚大，但驅動治療抗藥性的機制尚未完全闡明。本研究整合病人腫瘤標本的單細胞 RNA 測序與空間轉錄組學，解析肝臟腫瘤微環境與化療抗藥性之間的交互作用。我們識別出一個以 Secreted Phosphoprotein 1（SPP1）表現上升為標誌的特定巨噬細胞亞群，此亞群在 NAC 反應不佳者中顯著富集。機制上，這些 SPP1+ 巨噬細胞呈現促腫瘤轉錄組特徵，並透過 SPP1-CD44 訊息傳遞軸直接抑制 CD8+ T 細胞的細胞毒殺功能，此現象已透過體外共培養試驗、大規模組織微陣列及多個同基因小鼠模型證實。在空間分布上，這些細胞散佈於腫瘤各處並形成密集屏障，將 CD8+ T 細胞隔離並驅使其耗竭。值得注意的是，此空間配置與細胞毒殺活性及適應性免疫訊號呈反向相關，進而強化局部免疫抑制生態位以維持化療抗藥性。這些數據提供了缺失的連結：有效的化療需要一個免疫活化的肝臟微環境，而 SPP1+ 巨噬細胞浸潤主動破壞此狀態，進而促成臨床抗藥性。在 CRLM 前臨床模型中，SPP1 阻斷與 anti-PD-1 產生協同作用，誘導顯著腫瘤消退並恢復 T 細胞功能。總結而言，我們的發現將 SPP1+ 巨噬細胞定位為 CRLM 中 NAC 抗藥性的核心驅動者，並凸顯其所形成之空間免疫屏障為克服化療抗藥性及改善免疫治療反應的潛在治療靶點。

papers.title: Spatial multi-omics-guided drug development in inflammatory bowel disease: from mucosal immune niches to precision therapy
papers.authors: Wang H, Zhao X, Yang J
papers.abstract: Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis are now treated with an expanding set of biologics and small molecules, yet treatment selection remains largely empirical. Primary non-response, secondary loss of response, incomplete mucosal healing, fibrostenosis, and fistulizing disease show that conventional clinical, endoscopic, and bulk molecular markers do not capture how disease is organized within tissue. This review argues that the inflamed intestine is better viewed as a set of spatially structured mucosal immune niches rather than as uniform inflammation, with epithelial, myeloid, lymphoid, stromal, vascular, neural, and microbiome-associated cells communicating through defined cytokine and ligand-receptor circuits. In this framework, mucosal immune niches can be considered functional tissue units that link tissue-resolved mechanisms to therapeutic target discovery, pharmacodynamic assessment, biomarker qualification, and biomarker-enriched trial design. Single-cell atlases and spatial multi-omics, interpreted through computational modeling, can identify disease-driving cellular neighborhoods, ligand-receptor circuits, and compartment-specific vulnerabilities in both diseases. We discuss how these spatial features may inform target discovery, mechanism-of-action validation, patient stratification, response prediction, and trial design, using pathways such as TNF, IL-23, OSM, TL1A, integrins, JAK-STAT, and S1P as examples. At present, the realistic value of spatial data lies in generating mechanistic hypotheses, defining pharmacodynamic endpoints, and enriching trials, not in guiding routine treatment selection. Most candidate spatial biomarkers remain at the discovery or early translational stage and require standardized sampling, harmonized computation, longitudinal assessment, and multicenter validation. A staged translational path is proposed, moving from disease-specific atlases to spatial pharmacodynamic endpoints and adaptive precision trials, while also offering a comparative framework for studying chronic inflammation across mucosal organs.

papers.abstract_zh: 克隆氏症與潰瘍性結腸炎目前可用的生物製劑與小分子藥物種類日益增多，但治療選擇大多仍憑經驗。原發性無反應、次發性反應喪失、黏膜癒合不完全、纖維化狹窄與瘻管形成等現象，顯示傳統臨床、內視鏡與整體（bulk）分子標記無法反映疾病在組織內的空間組織方式。本綜述主張，發炎的腸道較適合被視為一組空間結構化的黏膜免疫微環境（niches），而非均質性發炎，其中上皮、骨髓、淋巴、間質、血管、神經與微生物相關細胞透過特定的細胞因子與配體-受體迴路相互溝通。在此框架下，黏膜免疫微環境可被視為功能性組織單位，連結組織層級機轉與治療靶點發現、藥效學評估、生物標記確認，以及生物標記富集之試驗設計。單細胞圖譜與空間多體學經計算模型解讀後，可識別兩種疾病中驅動疾病的細胞鄰域、配體-受體迴路與區室特異性脆弱性。本文討論這些空間特徵如何可能用於靶點發現、作用機轉驗證、病人分層、反應預測與試驗設計，並以TNF、IL-23、OSM、TL1A、integrin、JAK-STAT與S1P等路徑為例說明。目前，空間資料的實際價值在於產生機轉假說、定義藥效學終點與富集試驗，而非指導常規治療選擇。大多數候選空間生物標記仍處於發現或早期轉譯階段，需要標準化取樣、協調化運算、長期追蹤評估與多中心驗證。本文提出一個分階段轉譯路徑，從疾病特異性圖譜推進至空間藥效學終點與適應性精準試驗，同時提供一個跨黏膜器官研究慢性發炎的比較框架。

papers.title: Progress on the regulation of colorectal cancer and cardio-oncology by the gut microbiota and nutrients
papers.authors: Liu A, Tan R, Zhou X, Wang P, Wang X
papers.abstract: As one of the most common malignant tumors worldwide, the pathogenesis of colorectal cancer (CRC) was complex. Recent studies have revealed that dysbiosis of the gut microbiota and abnormal nutritional metabolism played a key role in the occurrence and development of tumors. With the rapid development of cardio-oncology, the cardiovascular toxicity risks faced by CRC patients during radiotherapy, chemotherapy, targeted therapy, and immunotherapy have become increasingly prominent, emerging as a key factor affecting long-term patient outcomes. However, there was currently a lack of systematic integration regarding the mechanisms underlying the interplay between the gut microbiota, nutritional interventions, and cardio-oncology in the management of CRC. This article aims to review the mechanisms underlying the interaction between CRC and the gut microbiota, the effects of nutritional interventions on the gut microbiota and tumor progression, and the important role of cardio-oncology in the treatment of CRC. This review examines the emerging evidence on how gut microbiota and nutrition interact to influence CRC development, progression, and therapeutic response, and proposes a theoretical basis for integrating these insights into multidisciplinary comprehensive treatment strategies.

papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）作為全球最常見的惡性腫瘤之一，其發病機制複雜。近期研究顯示，腸道菌群失衡與營養代謝異常在腫瘤發生與發展中扮演關鍵角色。隨著心臟腫瘤學的快速發展，CRC患者在放療、化療、靶向治療及免疫治療過程中所面臨的心血管毒性風險日益突顯，已成為影響患者長期預後的重要因素。然而，目前對於腸道菌群、營養干預與心臟腫瘤學三者在CRC管理中交互作用機制，仍缺乏系統性整合。本文旨在綜述CRC與腸道菌群交互作用之機制、營養干預對腸道菌群及腫瘤進展之影響，以及心臟腫瘤學在CRC治療中的重要角色。本綜述檢視腸道菌群與營養如何交互影響CRC發生、進展及治療反應之新興證據，並提出將這些見解整合至多學科綜合治療策略之理論基礎。

papers.title: Neutrophil extracellular traps in colorectal cancer: a paradoxical nexus of tumor defense and disease progression
papers.authors: Ge Y, Kong W, Qian Y, Sun Y, Zhu G, Li J
papers.abstract: Neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) are extracellular networks of decondensed chromatin and granular proteins generated by neutrophils in response to activating stimuli. Growing evidence indicates that NETs participate in colorectal cancer (CRC) development through their interactions with chronic inflammation, immune regulation, coagulation, and tumor progression. However, their biological effects vary across disease settings, and the regulatory mechanisms specific to CRC have not been fully clarified. This review examines the roles of NETs at different stages of CRC, including the transition from inflammation to cancer, primary tumor growth, metastatic spread, treatment resistance, and CRC-associated complications. We discuss CRC-related mechanisms of NET formation involving tumor-derived chemokines, stromal cells, microbial dysbiosis, oncogenic signals, and ROS-dependent pathways. Available evidence also suggests that NETs are not uniformly pro-tumorigenic. We therefore describe a "paradoxical nexus" in which their effects depend on tumor genotype, neutrophil phenotype, immune context, and the stimulus inducing NET formation. In addition, we review NET-related biomarkers, detection methods, and therapeutic approaches, while considering the evidence required for their clinical application and for context-specific treatment of CRC.

papers.abstract_zh: 嗜中性球胞外誘捕網（NETs）是嗜中性球受活化刺激後產生的去凝縮染色質與顆粒蛋白所組成的胞外網狀結構。越來越多證據顯示，NETs透過與慢性發炎、免疫調節、凝血及腫瘤進展的交互作用，參與大腸直腸癌（CRC）的發展。然而，其生物效應在不同疾病情境下有所差異，且CRC特異性的調控機轉尚未完全釐清。本綜述檢視NETs在CRC不同階段的角色，包括由發炎轉變為癌症、原發腫瘤生長、轉移擴散、治療抗性，以及CRC相關併發症。我們討論CRC相關NET形成機轉，涉及腫瘤衍生趨化因子、基質細胞、微生物菌叢失衡、致癌訊號及ROS依賴路徑。現有證據也顯示NETs並非一致地促進腫瘤生成。因此我們描述一種「矛盾交會」現象，其效應取決於腫瘤基因型、嗜中性球表現型、免疫情境及誘發NET形成的刺激物。此外，我們也回顧NET相關生物標記、偵測方法及治療策略，並探討其臨床應用及CRC情境特異性治療所需的證據。

papers.title: H19 and the PD-1/PD-L1 Axis in hepatocellular carcinoma and colorectal cancer: emerging evidence, mechanistic links, and therapeutic perspectives
papers.authors: Nami M, EmamiPari F, Farrokhi N, Fattahyan I, Yekkalam M
papers.abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and colorectal cancer (CRC) are major causes of cancer-related mortality, yet responses to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) remain heterogeneous. Although programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) is a key component of immune checkpoint biology, antitumor immunity is shaped by multiple tumor-intrinsic and microenvironmental factors, and the contribution of the long non-coding RNA H19 to these processes remains incompletely defined. This narrative review synthesizes experimental and clinical evidence linking H19 to immune regulation in HCC and CRC, with particular emphasis on its potential intersection with PD-L1-mediated immune checkpoint signaling. Evidence was classified as experimentally demonstrated, indirectly supported, contextual, or hypothetical according to the strength, mechanistic resolution, and disease specificity of the available data. Current evidence indicates that H19 perturbation can influence PD-L1-associated phenotypes in selected experimental HCC models; however, a complete, mechanistically resolved H19-dependent PD-L1 regulatory axis, including validated intermediate mechanisms and causal rescue, has not been established in HCC or CRC. Proposed ceRNA and signaling mechanisms remain incompletely validated, while several mechanistic links are supported primarily by indirect or cross-cancer evidence. Beyond direct checkpoint regulation, H19-associated extracellular vesicles and H19-dependent signaling have been implicated in macrophage remodeling, intercellular communication, and T-cell dysfunction, although direct convergence of these processes on H19-mediated PD-L1 regulation remains unproven. Circulating H19 has also shown preliminary associations with tumor presence or burden, but its clinical utility as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker remains insufficiently validated, particularly for ICI response. Overall, H19 represents a biologically plausible interface between non-coding RNA regulation, tumor-intrinsic signaling, and the tumor immune microenvironment rather than an established central regulator of PD-L1. Disease-specific mechanistic studies incorporating H19 perturbation, PD-L1 measurement, pathway-specific rescue, and immune-functional assays are required to determine whether H19 can serve as a clinically actionable component of immune checkpoint regulation.

papers.abstract_zh: 肝細胞癌（HCC）與大腸直腸癌（CRC）是癌症相關死亡的主要原因，然而對免疫檢查點抑制劑（ICIs）的反應仍具高度異質性。雖然程式性死亡配體1（PD-L1）是免疫檢查點生物學的關鍵組成，抗腫瘤免疫受到多重腫瘤內在與微環境因子的塑造，而長非編碼RNA H19在這些過程中的貢獻仍未完全闡明。本敘述性綜述整合了HCC與CRC中將H19與免疫調控連結之實驗與臨床證據，特別聚焦於其與PD-L1介導之免疫檢查點訊號可能的交互作用。證據依據資料強度、機轉解析度及疾病特異性，分類為實驗證實、間接支持、情境相關或假設性。目前證據顯示，在選定的HCC實驗模型中，H19的干擾可影響PD-L1相關表型；然而，一個完整、機轉上已解析的H19依賴性PD-L1調控軸，包括經驗證的中介機轉與因果性救援實驗，在HCC或CRC中尚未建立。所提出的ceRNA與訊號傳導機轉仍未完全驗證，多項機轉連結主要由間接證據或跨癌種證據所支持。除直接的檢查點調控外，H19相關的細胞外囊泡與H19依賴性訊號傳導亦被牽涉於巨噬細胞重塑、細胞間通訊及T細胞功能失調，但這些過程是否確實匯聚於H19介導的PD-L1調控仍未獲證實。循環H19也顯示出與腫瘤存在或腫瘤負荷之初步關聯，但其作為診斷、預後或預測性生物標記（尤其是ICI反應預測）之臨床效用仍驗證不足。整體而言，H19代表非編碼RNA調控、腫瘤內在訊號傳導與腫瘤免疫微環境之間一個具生物學合理性的介面，而非已確立的PD-L1中央調控者。需要進行疾病特異性的機轉研究，納入H19干擾、PD-L1測量、路徑特異性救援實驗及免疫功能分析，以確定H19是否能成為免疫檢查點調控中具臨床可操作性的一環。
